searchText: Hi Mario, we pass all tests except 5 BLS tests. So the tests look good from our side. Those 5 BLS tests have been passed by other clients (Nethermind) so we likely have something wrong on our side 🙂 (PR to track our progress + any bugs found: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/3400 )
